Test Title: Verify validation error when submitting empty credentials
Preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
Test Steps: 1. Leave Username field empty. 2. Leave Password field empty. 3. Click 'Login' button.
Expected Result: Inline validation message 'Required' should appear under both Username and Password fields; form should not submit.
Actual Result: 'Required' validation message displayed under both input fields as expected.

Test Title: Verify password field masking for security
Preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid or test password in Password input. 2. Observe character display.
Expected Result: All typed characters must be masked as dots/asterisks (type='password') to prevent shoulder surfing.

Test Title: Verify unauthorized access attempt via direct URL without login
Preconditions: User is not logged in; browser cache/session cleared
Test Steps: 1. Directly enter protected URL in browser address bar (e.g. /web/index.php/dashboard/index). 2. Press Enter.
Expected Result: System should intercept unauthenticated request and immediately redirect to login page (/auth/login).
Actual Result: User intercepted and redirected to login page.

Test Title: Verify mandatory field validation when adding employee with empty names
Preconditions: Admin is logged in and on 'Add Employee' page (PIM > Add Employee)
Test Steps: 1. Clear First Name and Last Name fields. 2. Click 'Save' button.
Expected Result: Validation errors 'Required' must appear below First Name and Last Name; employee record must not be created.
Actual Result: Validation error 'Required' displayed under both fields; form submission blocked.

Test Title: Verify adding employee with special characters in name (hyphens and apostrophes)
Preconditions: Admin is logged in and on 'Add Employee' page
Test Steps: 1. Enter First Name with hyphen (e.g. 'Mary-Jane'). 2. Enter Last Name with apostrophe (e.g. 'O\'Connor'). 3. Click 'Save'. 4. Verify saved profile.
Expected Result: System should accept valid name punctuations and display correctly without corruption or truncation.
Actual Result: Employee successfully saved and name displayed correctly in profile.

Preconditions: Admin is logged in and an employee with ID '0088' exists
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Add Employee. 2. Enter valid First and Last names. 3. Enter existing Employee ID '0088'. 4. Click 'Save'.
Expected Result: System displays inline error 'Employee Id already exists' and blocks creation of duplicate ID.
Actual Result: Error 'Employee Id already exists' displayed as expected.

Test Title: Verify search behavior with special characters and non-existent username
Preconditions: Admin is logged in and on Admin > User Management screen
Test Steps: 1. Enter special characters/SQL payload (e.g. 'test\' OR 1=1 --') in Username search. 2. Click 'Search'.
Expected Result: System handles input safely, displays '(0) Records Found' or 'No Records Found' without SQL/script execution.
Actual Result: Displayed 'No Records Found' cleanly without errors.

Test Title: Verify password complexity validation when adding a new system user
Preconditions: Admin is logged in and on Admin > Add User screen
Test Steps: 1. Select User Role and Employee Name. 2. In Password field enter weak password 'abc'. 3. Observe validation.
Expected Result: System displays 'Should have at least 7 characters' and 'Your password must contain minimum 1 number'.
Actual Result: Complexity hints displayed and Save disabled until criteria met.

Test Title: Verify system prevents deletion of currently logged-in Admin user
Preconditions: Admin is logged in as 'Admin' and on User Management screen
Test Steps: 1. Search for user 'Admin'. 2. Observe Actions column for the Admin row.
Expected Result: Delete button/checkbox should be disabled or action blocked to prevent self-lockout.
Actual Result: Delete action disabled/hidden for active logged-in admin session.

Test Title: Verify date validation when 'To Date' is earlier than 'From Date'
Preconditions: User is on Leave > Apply page
Test Steps: 1. Select valid Leave Type. 2. Set From Date to '2026-10-15'. 3. Set To Date to '2026-10-10'. 4. Click outside or submit.
Expected Result: System displays validation error 'To date should be after from date'; form submission blocked.
Actual Result: Validation error displayed and form submission prevented.

Test Title: Verify application blocked when user has zero leave balance
Preconditions: User has 0.00 entitlement balance for selected leave type
Test Steps: 1. Select leave type with 0 days balance. 2. Enter date range. 3. Observe leave balance display and submit button.
Expected Result: System alerts 'Balance not sufficient' or disables submission when overdraft is prohibited.
Actual Result: System displayed balance notice and blocked submission.

Test Title: Verify manual input of invalid calendar date format
Preconditions: User is on Leave > Apply page
Test Steps: 1. In From Date field, manually type invalid date '2026-15-45'. 2. Tab out.
Expected Result: System displays validation message 'Should be a valid date in format YYYY-MM-DD'.
Actual Result: Error message displayed under date field.
